Commercial window installation in Winnipeg

We supply and install aluminum and fiberglass windows for multi-unit buildings and offices, on new construction and retrofit projects.

On new construction we set windows into prepared openings and tie them into the air and water barrier. On retrofit jobs we remove the old units, prepare the opening, and install, insulate and seal the new ones.

Supply and installation come as one package, so the windows are ordered to the sizes we measured and one company answers for the result.

Common questions

Do you supply the windows or only install them?
We supply and install. The quote covers the windows, the installation and the sealing.
What do you need to quote a window job?
The window schedule and elevations for new construction. For a retrofit, the number of openings, rough sizes and photos are enough to start.
Do you work outside Winnipeg?
Yes. We are based in Winnipeg and take projects across Manitoba.
